name: Razor - Venus Hair Removal Razor for Women with Aloe Vera - Single Piece Razor
description:
Venus Hair Removal Razor for Women with Aloe Vera – Single Piece
Key Features:

Glide Strip with Aloe Vera & Vitamin E – Smoothens skin while shaving

Flexible Pivoting Head – Adapts to body curves for a smooth shave

Three Movable Blades – Removes even fine hair for a close and clean shave

Easy Grip Rubber Handle – Comfortable and safe to use in the shower

Lubricating Strip Present – Reduces friction and prevents irritation

Pain-Free Hair Removal – Removes hair without strong chemicals

Additional Information:

Maximum Shelf Life: 36 months

Ideal for regular use, giving a smooth and fresh feel in just one stroke
